The IT manager will roll out the IT strategy, and lead the department ensuring the effective planning, implementation, and maintenance of all IT systems and infrastructure within the organization. The IT Manager plays a pivotal role in aligning technology strategies with the overall business objectives, fostering innovation, and ensuring the security and reliability of the IT environment.Responsibilities:• IT strategy: Define and implement the IT vision and strategy of the company and translate into a coherent roadmap. • IT PMO: Manage the IT-portfolio with respect to planning, budget, risks and ensuring adequate resource staffing together with providers and business• IT Goverance: Ensure adequate governance throughout the lifecyle of projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely delivery and budget adherence. • Technology Evaluation: Stay abreast of emerging technologies, assess their potential for the organization, and make recommendations for adoption. • IT Operations: Oversee all technology operations and evaluate them according to established goals and service levels. • Incident Management: Ensure a stable IT landscape and close follow up and resolution of incidents and problems. • Infrastructure Management: Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of the organization's IT infrastructure, including networks, servers, and systems. • Security and Compliance: Establish and enforce security policies and procedures to protect the organization's digital assets. • Vendor Management: Evaluate and manage relationships with external vendors, negotiate contracts, and ensure service level agreements are met. • Team Management: Lead, mentor, and manage a small team of IT professionals, fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment. • Stakeholder Management: manage relationships with internal stakeholders, ranging from employees to Exco-members, and external IT partners.

 

Skills: 

• Proven professional experience of min 5 years in IT management or a similar role. 

• Minimum bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related f ield. A Master's degree is preferred. 

• Relevant certifications such as PMP or ITIL are advantageous. 

• Experience in working in an outsourced IT service model 

• Experience in supplier management, experience in IT contract negotiations is a plus 

• Experience in negotiating and managing IT budgets 

• Able to work independently, self-motivated 

• Good language skills in English, French and Dutch 

• Strong leadership and management in leading IT initiatives and driving organizational change. 

• Strong organization abilities including ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and activities among numerous tasks. 

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify and address complex technical issues. 

• Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey technical information to non-technical stakeholders. 

• Good knowledge of ERP tools (ideally Microsoft tools like Business Central, Dynamics 365) is a plus 

• Good knowledge of the Microsoft technology stack, Azure, Intune, Defender, AD 

• Good knowledge of Cyber Security best practices, knowledge of a related framework (CIS Controls, ISO 27001)

Are you an experienced .NET Developer who thrives in the ever-changing world of software development? Then we have exciting opportunities for you!

We are looking for multiple freelance professionals for different projects. Your personal passion, interests and experience will be decisive in setting the right accents and determining your personal journey.

• 
You stay up-to-speed with the latest technologies and have a curious and inquisitive attitude. This applies to development environments, methodologies, and tools.

 

Your Requirements:

• Bachelor's or Master’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience (2+ years developer experience).
• Dutch or French speaking with a strong knowledge of English.
• 
You are located in Belgium & able to work on-site/remote depending on the client needs.

Are you an experienced Data Engineer who thrives in the ever-changing world of Information Technology? Then we have exciting opportunities for you!

We are looking for multiple freelance professionals for different projects. Your personal passion, interests and experience will be decisive in setting the right accents and determining your personal journey.

Your job responsibilities:

• Have experience in one or more of the following: data modelling, data warehousing, databases, ETL/ELT. Experience in data warehouse automation is considered as a plus.
• Knowledge of advanced data analysis tools and programming languages such as Python, R, SQL, or Java. Strong knowledge of PowerBI & Databricks are a must.

• Creating data mappings, implementing standards, clean up data and implementing reference datasets.
• Deep experience applying advanced analytics to a variety of business situations and a proven ability to synthesize complex data, as well as a deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques and their mathematical underpinnings, and the ability to translate this into business implications for our clients.
 

Your Requirements:

• Bachelor's or Master’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Business engineering, business management or equivalent experience (5+ years).
• Dutch or French speaking with a strong knowledge of English.
• You are located in Belgium & able to work on-site/remote depending on the client’s needs.
You will work at a variety of large enterprises depending on your interest and your preferred way of working. At Brainbridge we cover the IT landscape from A to Z.

Role:

The company is an international and renowned expert in business automation through specialization and innovation in its niche market segments. The team consists of about 60 ambitious employees. The company stands for a no-nonsense mentality and flexibility. Do you value an informal work atmosphere, where everyone's opinion is important? Are you passionate about technology? Are you open to a new challenging job? Do you have the right skills and the right drive? Then this is the perfect opportunity for you! 

 

You are responsible for the entire application development process; together with your colleagues you build the perfect solution for the customer. 

To do so, you are assisted by a softwarearchitect with whom you determine the optimal architecture. From there, you take up your responsibility in the development cycle: from development and design to implementation and documentation. 

Thanks to our flat hierarchy your contribution to the result is always visible. You will join a team of other .Net developers in which knowledge sharing and teamwork are basic elements. 

However, independence is also required from time to time. The team is responsible for the complete implementation of projects: from the start-up and configuration to the final delivery.

Furthermore, they work on our newest E-trade products each day. Both products have an annual release program and roadmap in which you are an important link.

 

Your profile

• You bring a solid foundation with a bachelor's degree in IT, or you've carved your path through rich, hands-on experience. 
• Our technical journey includes substantial experience with C#, ASP.NET, and .NET Core, with bonus points for familiarity in Entity Framework, Microservices, Kubernetes and more. Any knowledge of Azure, Fiddler, Git and/or DevOps would be great as well. 
• Your proficiency in both Dutch and English is impeccable, enabling smooth and effective communication
• A sense of humor is always a plus. 
• As a collaborative team player, your open-mindedness and customer focus shine in every project. 
• You are dedicated to continuous learning, always eager to expand your expertise and skills in the ever-evolving IT landscape. 
• Your approach to customer interaction is both seamless and amiable, fostering positive and lasting relationships. 
• 
You are flexible and are open to the opportunity of occasional short trips abroad, adding a global dimension to your role.

To take cloud adoption to its fullest extent, you’ll use your analytical and governance skills, problem-solving abilities, and cross-functional team collaboration to drive innovation and efficiency in cloud environments.

Your days will consist of automating and maintaining our systems as well as developing scripts that optimize our infrastructure and align cloud systems to always serve our business goals. You’ll use your expertise in cloud platforms (Azure & AWS), automation frameworks, containerization, virtualization, networking, and security practices to drive digital transformation. Our goal is to build reliable and cost-efficient systems. As a (Cloud) System Engineer, you’ll make it happen by designing, implementing, and supporting scalable cloud environments, streamlining deployment processes and reducing manual interventions.

As a quality and compliance expert, you will be responsible for ensuring that GxP systems and processes adhere to the applicable regulatory requirements throughout the entire system lifecycle. Therefore, you stay up to date about evolving regulations from authorities such as the EMA and FDA and industry standards like GAMP and ISO. Depending on your role and expertise, you may be asked to provide Quality & Compliance support during audits and inspections, or to join a Sopra Steria validation service team.

As a trusted Computerized System Validation (CSV) Engineer, you play a key role in the validation process of the computerized systems used by our clients in the Life Sciences sector. More specifically, your mission is to ensure the quality and regulatory compliance of GxP systems throughout their entire life cycle and across all GxP areas (GLP, GCP, GMP, GDP, GPvP). Systems in scope can include site-specific lab instruments (e.g. HPLC software) and production equipment (e.g. capsule filling machine), but also globally used web applications, Clinical Trial Management Systems, complex Manufacturing Execution Systems, SAP systems, medical devices, etc…

Our experts thoroughly test our solutions to ensure we’re always on the safest path to positive outcomes and meet the high standards we set ourselves. As a testing expert, you’ll create and execute test plans, both manual and automated, using the latest test management tools. You’ll have an eye for bugs and imperfections, identifying and documenting defects and tracking bugs before they become problematic. We trust our testers to identify the safest, most efficient path to a solution while paying scrupulous attention to details and maintaining their expertise by staying up to date on the latest software development life cycles to ensure software quality and performance.

As a Test Engineer, you’ll ensure the smooth operation of our software across departments through testing and quality assurance.

You have the following knowledge and experience: 

• You’re a team player with excellent communication skills and a student of emerging industry trends.
